article.headline: Scores from last Night: Seminary finishes region play unbeaten; Tupelo reaches 10–0
article.html:
Seminary beat Magee 35–7 on Thursday, October 29, finishing its Class 3A Region 6 schedule unbeaten at 4–0. Tupelo added another shutout to its perfect season, winning 44–0 at Lewisburg to reach 10–0.

Elsewhere, Tishomingo County edged North Pontotoc 43–42, Hernando swept its soccer matches at Starkville, and Lake Austin scored 17 points in Woodlawn Prep’s 42–36 basketball win at Lamar Christian.

Seminary finishes atop Region 6

Seminary’s home win over Magee left the Bulldogs 9–1 overall and first in 3A Region 6. Their posted final region record was 4–0, and the victory extended their winning streak to seven games. Magee finished 7–2 overall.

Dean throws four touchdown passes for Tupelo

Tupelo quarterback Drew Dean completed 13 of 19 passes for 129 yards and four touchdowns without an interception in the 44–0 win at Lewisburg. The Golden Wave outscored the Patriots 21–0 in the second quarter. Lewisburg finished 3–6.

The Seminary–Magee, Tupelo–Lewisburg, Kossuth–Alcorn Central and Potts Camp–Falkner matchups were among the games in our Thursday Games To Watch preview. Their finals brought decisive wins for Seminary, Tupelo, Kossuth and Potts Camp.

Tishomingo County survives by one; East Webster wins by six

Tishomingo County won 43–42 at North Pontotoc, moving to 5–4 while the Vikings finished 4–6. East Webster beat visiting Eupora 20–14 to finish 9–1; Eupora stood at 8–2 after the six-point decision.

Kossuth won 29–6 at Alcorn Central, scoring 16 points in the second quarter and 13 in the fourth. Central’s six points came in the third. Kossuth finished 6–3 overall and 3–1 in 3A Region 1; Central finished 5–5 overall.

Potts Camp shut out Falkner 35–0 on the road. The Cardinals improved to 6–2, while Falkner finished 5–4.

Hernando takes two at Starkville

Hernando’s boys won 3–1 at Starkville after the teams reached halftime tied 1–1. The Tigers scored twice after the break and held the Yellowjackets scoreless in the second half, moving to 2–0. Starkville finished 1–1.

Hernando’s girls won 6–2, building a 5–1 halftime lead. That result also left the Tigers 2–0, while Starkville finished 0–2.

Caledonia and Itawamba Agricultural split a pair of one-goal matches. Caledonia’s boys won 3–2, leaving both teams 1–1. Itawamba’s girls won 2–1 to reach 2–0, with Caledonia at 1–1.

Sumrall sweeps shutouts at St. Martin

Sumrall kept St. Martin off the scoreboard in both matches: the boys won 3–0 and the girls won 2–0. The Bobcats’ girls remained perfect at 4–0, while their boys finished 2–1–1. Both St. Martin teams stood at 1–1.

Austin leads Woodlawn Prep in opening win

Woodlawn Prep opened with a 42–36 win at Lamar Christian behind Lake Austin’s 17 points and seven rebounds. The Wolfpack outscored Lamar 20–6 in the second quarter, then held on as the Lions took the fourth quarter 16–4. Woodlawn finished 1–0 and Lamar Christian 2–1.
